title: ACAT Word Predictor Settings
description: Configuration for word prediction in ACAT - maps languages to their preferred word predictor engines

wordPredictors.description: List of preferred word predictor mappings per language

wordPredictorEntry.description: Mapping of a language to its preferred word predictor

language.description: Language code (ISO 639-1 two-letter code, optionally with region)

id.description: Unique identifier (GUID) of the preferred word predictor for this language. Use '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' for the default/null predictor.

wordPredictorGlobalSettings.description: Global settings controlling word prediction behavior

enabled.description: Whether word prediction is enabled globally

maxSuggestions.description: Maximum number of word suggestions to display

learnFromInput.description: Whether the word predictor should learn from user input to improve suggestions

showPredictionsOnScannerPanel.description: Show word predictions in the scanner panel
